excerpt: The Community Phone Base plugs into a power outlet and connects any regular landline phone to nearby cellular towers, so it gives a dial tone without a phone jack, internet or copper wiring.
Number transfer (porting) from any carrier is free and takes about 5 business days. Customers keep their current service until the transfer completes.
Community Phone works with almost any corded or cordless phone. Just plug your existing handset into the Base, or we’ll send you one if you need it.
Setup takes minutes: plug the Base into power and plug the phone into the Base. No technician and no installation fee.
A 26-hour battery keeps you connected. If the power goes out, the Base keeps working, so you can make calls.
We block 99% of spam and scam calls automatically, before they ever reach your phone.
Community Phone works across all 50 states, and we’re adding coverage every week. Check what’s available at your address in a few seconds.
The Base uses larger, more powerful antennas than a cell phone, so it holds a connection even where typical cell phones struggle.
No contract, ever. Plans start at $45/mo before taxes and government-mandated fees, with a Three-Year Price Lock, so your price won’t rise like it does with other providers.
Built-in spam call blocking on every plan. Unlimited calling within the US.
Call, chat, or email — our caring support team picks up in under two minutes.
Customers manage their line, calls and voicemail in the Community Phone app and the online dashboard.
call forwarding, block unwanted numbers, advanced call activity with history and trends, voicemail you can listen to in the app or read as texts
Everything in the Home plan, plus: keep an eye on their calls, read their voicemails like texts, and decide who can call them.
you can choose who can call your loved one, monitor their activity from your app, and set up automated calls to check on them or remind them as needed.
Incoming calls can ring multiple numbers at once, or roll to different numbers if the first one isn’t answered
Send and receive texts with customers through your dashboard or mobile app. (Business Plus)
Add users and manage every number. Set up call routing and call forwarding
Answer business calls from anywhere. Send and reply to business texts. Read voicemail-to-text. Get instant missed-call alerts
Everything in Solo, plus: Share your business number with your team. Dial menu. Live transfer
Voicemail with transcriptions. Custom greeting for inbound calls. Advanced call routing
One number covers the front desk, back office, and warehouse — all on the same cordless system.
Everything in Business Team, plus a free additional virtual line and two-way SMS texting.
